children: Repligen announced a merger agreement to acquire BioLife for $11.25 cash plus 0.1442 Repligen shares per BioLife share.
Repligen will acquire all outstanding BioLife common stock for $11.25 cash and 0.1442 Repligen shares per share.
Transaction structured as two-step statutory mergers making BioLife a direct, wholly owned Repligen subsidiary upon closing.
HSR waiting period expired Sept 3, 2026; closing still subject to customary conditions including BioLife stockholder approval.
Special meeting of BioLife stockholders to vote on the merger is scheduled remotely for Oct 5, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET.
